name: nest-acticle
description: 博客平台 monorepo：NestJS 后端 + Vue3 管理端 + Nuxt4 博客前台

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @nest-acticle/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,admin,client,docs -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,dim "pnpm --filter @nest-acticle/shared dev" "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter admin dev" "pnpm --filter client dev" "pnpm --filter docs dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter server lint && pnpm --filter admin lint
